column1: # Known differences between scopeio and the reference readers: lossy tiles decoded with

# JPEG 2000: scopeio's samples equal OpenJPEG's (ImageMagick, black box) on every pixel of a
# checked tile; Bio-Formats' decoder is 0.5 to 1.3 lower on average.
